name: analytics-ecommerce

description: A glass ecommerce dashboard for React: sales, orders, top products, funnel and regions with a time-range picker and animated KPIs. Free, Tailwind v4.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
E-commerce: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/dashboards/ecommerce

Installed in components/sheenui/blocks/. Import (use your components alias):
import { EcommerceDashboard } from "@/components/sheenui/blocks/analytics-ecommerce";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
